_about: Check-in DMs for quiet members (GreMi 2026-10-14), run by bot/checkin.py and read live. 'on': false stops sending; the buttons keep working. {name} is the member's server name. 'welcome' is sent after ✅.
text: Hey {name}! I'm **Race Control**, GreMi's bot. GreMi streams EA F1 and Le Mans Ultimate and races with his viewers in open lobbies. We haven't seen you in a while, so: still up for being part of the gang? 👀
welcome: **Awesome, welcome back! 🏁** A lot changed since you were last here:
🎭 Pick your roles in **Channels & Roles** (top of the channel list). They unlock F1, LMU, leagues and more, and chats like F1-CHAT stay hidden without them.
🎁 Weekly €10 gift card giveaway: get the Prize Hunter role and hit Enter in GIVEAWAYS.
🤖 Tag @Race Control in the server with any question.
🛒 Code **GREMI10** gets you 10% off at Simgasm.
